description: This source file defines API endpoints related to 'roles' management within a web application backend, utilizing FastAPI. It includes routes to list roles, retrieve a specific role by ID, and create new roles. The file interacts with the database via a Supabase client and includes authentication guards for admin-only operations.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance handling the roles-related endpoints.

methods.name: list_roles( authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, description="Optional: Bearer <Supabase JWT> for personalized RLS; falls back to anon read"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all roles, with support for optional authorization for personalized data if a Bearer token is provided.

methods.name: get_role( role_id: int, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, description="Optional: Bearer <Supabase JWT>; falls back to anon read"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific role by its ID, with optional authorization for access control.

methods.name: create_role( payload: RoleIn, authorization: str = Header(..., description="Bearer <Supabase JWT>"), _: AuthUser = Depends(AdminGuard()), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new role, restricted to admins via dependency injection.
